delve.already_active: You already have an active delve! Use the flee button to escape.
delve.auto_rescue_wait: ⏳ Your {pet} is working to free you. Check back in {minutes} minute(s).
delve.auto_rescued: 🆘 You've been rescued! Your loyal {pet} dragged you from the darkness! You're free to delve again.

combat.ambush_desc: A creature bursts from the shadows, catching you off guard!
combat.bone_wraith_pierce: The Bone Wraith's strike pierces your armor!
combat.entangled: You are entangled and your attack is weakened!
combat.flee_description: You flee the depths, escaping with your life. You lose {gold} gold.
combat.fortified: Your fortified weapon glows. Extra damage!
combat.guarded_absorb: Your guard absorbs part of the blow!
combat.marked_warning: You feel an unnatural mark upon you. Enemies hit harder.
combat.mend: You mend your wounds, restoring {heal} HP.
combat.molten_core_explode: The Molten Core explodes for {damage} damage!
combat.navigate_collapse: Part of the ceiling collapses! Dust and debris fill the air.
combat.navigate_trap_avoid: You trigger a floor trap but roll clear just in time!
combat.navigate_trap_hit: The floor gives way! You take {damage} damage.
combat.plague_bearer_poison: The Plague Bearer's wound festers. Poison seeps into your veins!
combat.power_blow: You unleash a devastating blow for {damage} damage!
combat.spore_host_poison: The Spore Host bursts, releasing a cloud of toxic spores! You are poisoned.

delve.cooldown_death: You cannot delve again today. Wait for rescue or until tomorrow.
delve.death_auto_rescue: Your loyal {pet} refuses to leave your side! They will drag you to safety soon. Check back with `/delve` in a few minutes.
delve.death_fell: The darkness claims you on floor {floor}. Your limbs grow cold, your vision fades. {auto_msg}
delve.death_no_rescue: Your pets couldn't reach you. Another adventurer on this floor may find you and pull you back.
delve.fallen_wait: 💀 You fell on floor {floor}. Your pets couldn't reach you. Another adventurer may find you there, or try again tomorrow.

handler.boss_gate_desc: A massive guardian bars the path to floor {floor}. The air trembles with its presence. You must defeat it to go deeper.
handler.boss_victory: The {name} falls! The path deeper opens before you.
handler.death_auto_rescue_msg: Pet refuses to leave your side! They will drag you to safety soon.
handler.death_fallen_desc: The Undercroft has claimed you this day. Your journey ends for now.
handler.death_no_rescue_msg: Your pets could not reach you. Another adventurer on this floor may find you.
handler.defend_room: You raise your guard and slip past the creature. The next strike against you will be weakened.
handler.doppelganger: The victim snarls and transforms! It was a doppelganger lying in wait!
handler.flee_combat_fail: You stumble! The {enemy} lands a free hit for {damage} damage!
handler.flee_combat_success: You slip away from combat, leaving {gold} gold behind.
handler.flee_fail: You stumble as you try to flee! The enemy blocks your escape and lunges at you!
handler.flee_success: You slip away before the enemy can react, retreating to the safety of the passage.
handler.forge_scavenge: You scavenge useful parts from the workshop. +{gold} gold!
handler.forge_scavenge_key: You also find a Dungeon Key!
handler.forge_temper: You stoke the forge and temper your weapon. It glows with renewed strength. +5 ATK for the next combat.
handler.garden_burn: The garden burns brightly! You warm yourself in the flames and recover {heal} HP.
handler.garden_harvest_heal: You harvest a glowing sporefruit. It heals you for {heal} HP!
handler.garden_harvest_poison: The spores invade your lungs as you harvest. You feel poison spreading through your veins.
handler.graveyard_spook: A spectral figure materializes before you, offering a dusty relic. You accept and feel a chill settle over your soul.
handler.level_up: Level up! Now Level {level} (+2 skill points, ⭐ +1 perk choice, 👑 +1 crown)
handler.locked_force_fail: The door mechanism triggers a trap! You take {damage} damage.
handler.locked_force_success: You throw your shoulder against the door. It bursts open!
handler.locked_key_success: The key turns smoothly. Beyond the door lies a hidden chamber!
handler.merchant_haggle_fail: Think you are clever? the merchant sneers. Prices just went up.
handler.merchant_haggle_success: Your silver tongue earns you a nod. The merchant mutters, Fine, one discount but don't push it.
handler.no_potions_bandage: You have no potions to use as bandages!
handler.no_torches_burn: You have no torches to burn the garden!
handler.no_torches_forge: You need a torch to reheat the forge!
handler.npc_intimidate_success: You loom over the captive and snatch their belongings. They cower and do not resist.
handler.rest_bandage: You use a potion to clean and dress your wounds. +15 HP.
handler.rift_disturb: Your presence disturbs the rift! A being of pure chaos coalesces and attacks!
handler.rift_gaze_fail: The void gazes back! Pain sears your mind for {damage} damage.
handler.rift_gaze_success: You gaze into the void and glimpse forbidden knowledge. You feel enlightened. Your next victory will grant more XP.
handler.shrine_defile: You tear down the shrine and take {gold} gold. A dark weight settles over you.
handler.shrine_donate: You donate {gold} gold to the shrine. A gentle glow surrounds you. The blessing is yours.
handler.shrine_pray_fail: Your prayer goes unanswered. A wave of holy backlash burns you for {damage} damage!
handler.shrine_pray_success: You kneel before the shrine and pray. A warm light fills you. You feel blessed.
handler.spore_cloud: A cloud of glowing spores billows from a crack in the wall. You breathe them in before you can hold your breath. Poison courses through your veins.
handler.steam_vent_hit: Scalding steam blasts you from a vent! You take {damage} damage.
handler.steam_vent_seal: A steam vent hisses ominously. You jam a torch into the mechanism, sealing it. +{xp} XP
handler.tomb_open_empty: The sarcophagus is empty. Dust and disappointment.
handler.tomb_open_guardian: The sarcophagus lid explodes outward! An ancient guardian rises, fury in its hollow eyes.
handler.tomb_open_success: The sarcophagus creaks open revealing a gleaming treasure!
handler.tomb_respect: You bow before the ancient dead. A faint warmth settles in your chest. A blessing from the honored fallen.
handler.whispers: The void whispers your name. It offers power, and you accept. A shiver of insight and a weight settles into your bones.

delve.ignore_fallen: You turn away from the cries in the darkness and press on.
delve.left_voluntarily: You ascend from the depths, your adventure complete. The Undercroft will remember your descent.
delve.no_session: No active delve. Start one with `{prefix}delve`!
delve.rescue_already_gone: That player is no longer fallen.
delve.rescue_cost_hp: 🤝 You rescued {user} from the darkness! -10 HP
delve.rescue_no_torches_hp: You're too weak to rescue anyone!
delve.rescue_overlay: A faint voice calls from the shadows... someone needs help!
delve.rescued_by_player: A hand grips yours in the darkness. {rescuer} pulled you from the depths back to the light! You may now delve again.
delve.start_desc: You descend into the darkness. The air grows cold. Somewhere ahead, something stirs.
delve.too_frail: You are too frail to make such a sacrifice.
